met_analysis:
The Deep Depression over central parts of Chhattisgarh & adjoining north interior Odisha moved westwards with a speed of 8 kmph during past 6 hours, and lies centered at 1730 hrs IST of today, the 29th July 2026, over central parts of Chhattisgarh near latitude 21.9°N and longitude 82.3°E, about 30 km south-southeast of Bilaspur (Chhattisgarh), 40 km west-southwest of Champa (Chhattisgarh), 100 km northeast of Raipur (Chhattisgarh), 130 km northeast of Durg, 220 east-northeast of Gondia (Maharashtra), and 170 km east of Malanjkhand (Madhya Pradesh). It is very likely to move nearly westwards across Chhattisgarh, east Madhya Pradesh & adjoining Vidarbha and weaken gradually into a depression during next 24 hours.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level continues to pass through Sri Ganganagar, Sikar, Datiya, centre of Deep Depression over central parts of Chhattisgarh, Gopalpur thence southeastwards towards Central parts of Bay of Bengal and extends upto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The east-west shear zone roughly along latitude 23°N across central India between 3.1 & 7.6 km above mean sea level tilting southwards with height persists.
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over North Pakistan & adjoining Jammu division at 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northeast Assam at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
